u0: The box is in hand and progress toward the exit is underway. Keep it carried, move steadily to the exit; if box_fell occurs the state drops to recovery, and reaching the exit while still holding the box ends successfully in u1.
u1: The episode is complete: the box was carried onto the exit and the full reward was earned. This is a terminal state; no further objectives remain.
u2: The box has left your hands and you are in the fall-recovery state; you received a penalty for the fall. Your immediate objective is to pick the box up again on the very next action, which returns you to u0. If you reach the exit before recovering it, the episode stays in this failed terminal condition with no full reward.
